mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 9.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 9.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% in the past month, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve adopts accommodative monetary policy to support economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary tightening in response to high inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL YoY change increase, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO annual growth < 0.5%), industrial output contraction reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO annual growth < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
